sources.snippet: We also provide an example training script to train a Perceiver IO model for ImageNet classification. The provided hyperparameters are the settings used to train Perceiver IO with 2D Fourier position encodings, as described in section 4.5 and supplemental section H of the paper [2].

sources.title: Perceiver IO: A General Architecture for Structured Inputs & Outputs
sources.snippet: In this work, we propose Perceiver IO, a general-purpose architecture that handles data from arbitrary settings while scaling linearly with the size of inputs and outputs.

sources.snippet: Perceiver Architecture Relevant source files Purpose and Scope This document describes the Perceiver and Perceiver IO architecture, a general-purpose neural network design that can process many types of data (images, video, audio, 3D point clouds, language, multimodal combinations) with minimal domain-specific adaptations.
